title: OpenAI Secret API key: one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 73-character left segment vs contracted 74. Twin of "OpenAI Secret API key: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
